The complaint was accepted for rehearing in April 2018
The only reason given was that Mr. Miles Gould purchased a property in New York City at that time
PAG started a four-year legal battle against Mr. Miles Gould
Since the case was accepted, Edward Moss has served as the main lawyer representing PAG
In the past four years, Edward Moss submitted a large amount of unverifiable evidence from China to the court
And even documents with forged Mr. Miles Gould's signature
What's more is the New York court deprived Mr. Miles Gould's right to a jury trial without giving any reason
It was astounding that facing a flood of falsified evidence, the New York judge barred Mr. Miles Gould from questioning the veracity of any document
Something even more dramatic happened in October 2021
Edward Moss accepted an invitation from attorney Bradley Bondi to join Cahill LLP
Who is Bradley Bondi?
He is the lawyer who once represented Mr. Miles Gould in cases, including GTV
Bradley Bondi, as Mr. Miles Gould's former legal advisor, ignored professional ethics for lawyers, invited Edward Moss to
Fight side by side
And used the confidential information obtained when he served as Mr. Miles Gould's lawyer
to attack Mr. Miles Gould
Mr. Miles Gould's team of lawyers asked the three most
authoritative lawyers professional ethics evaluation agencies in the United States to give an evaluation
And finally found that Edward Moss seriously violated professional ethics
On January 14, 2022, the court ruled that the conflict of interest of PAG lawyers was established
And the attorney's qualification of the case representation must be lifted
Moss who represented PAG for five years was disqualified according to law
However, the falsified evidence he provided for the past five years
Has led the court to fine Mr. Miles Gould
For a total of 134 million US dollars
In general, the penalty for a guarantor who guarantees a loan agreement of 30 million dollars
Is not more than double the value of the original loan
Such a high penalty of nearly five times is never heard
Furthermore, the court even ruled the property on the 18th floor of 781 New York Avenue
And the lady may cruise ship
Which do not belong to Mr. Miles Gould
To pay for the fines
Yes, this is how things happened
Why are so many top American lawyers willing to work for the CCP
And even risk their reputation and future
The center of the problems is the CCP's infiltration over years
Using blackmailing, bribery, honey traps, tactics and China's huge market
Almost all Chinese companies are controlled by the CCP
MAS has law firms in Beijing Yintai area and Shanghai financial districts
As long as these elites collude with the CCP
They can easily access China's well-known companies
Such as Alibaba
Behind this are massive interests, collusion and corruption
What is the relationship between PAG and the Chinese Communist Party
Shan Weijian, the chairman and CEO of PAG
Was born in 1954 in Beijing
To a family of members of the foreign ministry
Which is known to be Communist China's intelligence agency
In 1975, during the Cultural Revolution
He wrote a letter to Mao Zedong and Zhou Enle to express his loyalty
And gain the opportunity to return to the city to study
It has always been the rule of the Communist Party
To only promote who has good roots, one of our own
Being a member of a family of foreign ministry
Shan Weijian was sent to study in the United States in 1982
He became the first foreign student from Red China
In the history of a University of San Francisco
He was also one of the first group of agents infiltrating the West
He then became the promoter of China's Thousand Talents program
To steal science and technology from the world
In 1998, Shan Weijian joined Newbridge Capital as a founding partner
Shan took only 12 years to become chairman and CEO of PAG in 2010
Shan's first successful investment project was Hainan Sonia Phoenix Airport
Which is part of HNA Group
When the CCP learned that Mr. Miles Wool started to expose the scandals
of Wang Chishan and HNA Group on April 19, 2017
PAG's Shan Weijian was ordered to launch legal actions against Mr. Miles Wool one day earlier
All the evidence points to one conclusion that PAG is the Hong Kong version of HNA Group
And Shan Weijian is the henchman for Wang Chishan and other kleptocratic families
To launder and hide money overseas
The PAG case is a typical example of the CCP's infiltration and corruption of the Western judicial system
The CCP uses it to set back Mr. Miles Wool's efforts in taking down the CCP
The CCP has mastered the so-called two-gun or even the multi-gun tactic to perfection
Ever since Mr. Miles Wool launched the whistleblower movement to take down the CCP in 2017
The CCP has not only used the power of its sleepers overseas to pursue legal action against Mr. Miles Wool
But also used Westerners who have been controlled by CCP's blackmail, bribery
And honey traps
To influence the U.S. federal government's decisions
With the intention of achieving the evil goal of deporting Mr. Miles Wool
A classic example of this is the involvement of George Higginbotham
A senior congressional affairs counselor of the Department of Justice
And Elliot Broidy, an American venture capitalist
In a covert campaign to influence the U.S. government for the interests of the CCP
George Higginbotham was the first U.S. Justice Department attorney to be criminally charged for corruption
He has accepted bribes from Zhou Lo, who has a Chinese communist background
And helped him launder money and funnel benefits to Elliot Broidy's lobbying with the goal of deporting Mr. Miles Wool
Both people confessed to their crimes
In the past five years of the whistleblower movement
The CCP has never stopped personal attacks and disinformation of Mr. Miles Wool
Now, the CCP uses the power of one country to get a verdict that requires Mr. Miles Wool
To provide a huge fine of $134 million within five days
Mr. Miles Wool has made a huge decision that he would rather file for personal bankruptcy than settle
The American juridical system is not perfect, but it is still the most balanced system that can self-correct mistakes
This is what makes America great
The PAG case is the best example of the Chinese Communist Party's blackmail, bribery and honey traps
Tactic to infiltrate the U.S. judicial system
Today's verdict has created a deep crack in the cornerstone of the rule of law that the United States has been most proud of
The ruling of the PAG case can no longer be overturned
And the lawyers involved in the falsification will spend their lives paying the price
Shangwei Jian and PAG must be investigated by the Department of Justice and independent prosecutors
And the U.S. Congress must be involved in investigating the truth
Otherwise, the U.S. cannot afford the harm and price brought by the PAG case
This is the only way that the United States and other Western civilized countries can take out the virus
Hidden in their sick body
And this virus is the Chinese Communist Party
On April 18, 2017, PAX, a subsidiary of the Pacific Alliance Group
Submitted a complaint against Mr. Miles Gould to the New York court
It is important to know that the complaint was that Mr. Miles Gould guaranteed a loan agreement between Pengu and PAX
In fact, PAG has recognized that Pengu has paid off the loan
So, the loan agreement should be automatically terminated
So as the guarantor agreement
How can PAX submit a complaint of a terminated agreement?
Moreover, even if the loan agreement remained
The creditor PAG should first demand the payment from Pengu
Not the guarantor, Mr. Miles Gould
Not only that, the place of the issuance and execution of the so-called guarantor agreement
And the residents of both parties are either China or Hong Kong
Which are not within the jurisdiction of the New York court
The complaint was rejected by New York court
